title: Digital offer covers copying but not creation
expected_artifacts: A finite-cohort economics record, obligation-gap note and bounded retain/revise/test recommendation. Do not create unrelated outputs or replace source evidence with the assessment. A blocked commitment can still have a complete, useful design or review record.
reference_findings: Gross consideration 2400, net consideration 2310, direct costs 500, direct contribution 1810 and creation-inclusive residual -190. The negative residual is for this finite cohort; it is not proof that every future sale is loss-making or that the whole venture must close. The verifier checks the fixed arithmetic; direct review must also examine evidence scope, causal limits and the requested business reasoning. A favourable calculation alone does not pass all growth gates.
negative_control: Fail a profitability claim based solely on copying cost, fabricated future volume, double-counted creation, or removal of purchased rights to fund the next edition.
preservation: Keep template-edition-v1 and its access rights. A future offer can be proposed separately; no existing customer entitlement is changed.
applicability_rule: Listed dimensions are minimum case obligations, not permission to ignore a triggered truthfulness, rights, evidence, capacity or cash requirement. Other dimensions may be NOT APPLICABLE only with a case-scope reason; missing relevant evidence is BLOCKED for the business decision, not inapplicable.
